description: This file declares the AWCContainer class, which implements container management functionalities such as start, stop, and state change notifications for AWC containers within the Thunder project.

classes.name: AWCContainer
classes.description: Implements container control and state management for AWC containers, including start, stop, and handling state change notifications.

methods.name: AWCContainer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the AWCContainer with an ID, client, and notifier.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Deleted copy assignment operator to prevent copying.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the container type, which is AWC.

methods.name: Pid
methods.description: Returns the process ID associated with the container.

methods.name: IsRunning
methods.description: Checks if the container is currently running.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the container with a specified command and parameters.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the container, with a specified timeout.

methods.name: notifyStateChange
methods.description: Handles notifications about state changes in the container.

methods.name: WaitUntilAWCReady
methods.description: Waits until the AWC container is ready for operations.
